scripts.text:
[Thug]
*Sigh...*
What is life?
And what use
is money? ...Damn.
Damn this worthless life!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
*叹气...*
人生是什么？
金钱又有什么用？...该死。
该死，这毫无价值的人生！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hey, kid.
What the hell
are you lookin' at?
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
喂，小鬼。
你他妈在看什么？

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Then get the
hell out of my face!
Didn't you hear me?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
那就滚出我的视线！
没听到吗？
滚蛋！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hmmm...
Maybe I'll swing by the ^0000FFRogue Guild^000000 in ^0000FFParos Lighthouse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
嗯...
也许我去^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔^000000的^0000FF流氓公会^000000逛逛...

scripts.text:
[Thug]
I needz my money,
and they best have it...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
我需要钱，
他们最好有...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Eh? You...you...?!
Hey, haven't we met before?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
咦？你...你...？！
嘿，我们以前见过吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
..............
Awww, ^FF0000I am sorry^000000! I think I misunderstood you from someone I know.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
..............
哎呀，^FF0000对不起^000000！我想我把你和我认识的人搞混了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
I never misunderstand people...oh well, be safe anyway!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
我从来不会认错人...算了，总之祝你平安！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Yo, what are you doin'?!
You can't change your job if you got unused skill points, so use 'em all up. You bettah check yo-self before you wreck yo-self.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哟，你在干什么？！
如果你有未使用的技能点，就无法转职，所以把它们都用掉吧。最好检查一下自己，别把自己搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I get it now...
The widdle boy wants
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
像你这样的小孩
来这里干什么？
哦，我明白了...
这个小男孩想成为^800000流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I see...
Lil' cutie wants 
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
像你这样的小孩
来这里干什么？
哦，我知道了...
小可爱想成为^800000流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Eh, nice meetin' you, I guess. I'm Markie, and I do work for the Rogue Guild, a philanthro-- *ahem* a ^800000feelanthropist^000000 group, as you can see. So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
呃，很高兴见到你，我想。我是马基，我在流氓公会工作，一个慈善... *咳咳* 一个^800000慈善^000000团体，正如你所见。那么，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
...{0}?
Heh heh! Cool name.
If it was dorky, we'd
make you change it,
so you're in luck.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
...{0}？
嘿嘿！酷名字。
如果很土气，我们会让你改的，
所以你运气不错。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So why you wanna join up with the Rogues? I guess you gave me your real name, so you'd be an honest Rogue. Not many of those around, heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
那你为什么想加入流氓？我想你给了我你的真名，所以你是个诚实的流氓。这样的人不多，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Rule number 1 for Rogues...
Never give out your real identity to most people, most of the time. It's just a little backup measure we like to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
流氓的第一条规则...
大多数时候，不要向大多数人透露你的真实身份。这只是我们喜欢使用的一个小备用措施。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Right. I'm officially accepting your application, so now you gotta take a test. Don't sweat it, this first one is real simple.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
好的。我正式接受你的申请，所以现在你得参加一个测试。别紧张，这个第一个测试非常简单。

[马基]
好的...
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
You again?
Okay, you probably screwed up last time 'cuz you were way too nervous. So just chill and pass
this test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
又是你？
好吧，你上次可能搞砸了，因为你太紧张了。所以放松点，通过这个测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Go talk to Smith. His test might be pretty hard. He's one of the guys who makes sure that people pay up their debts to us. So yeah, he might be a bit of a hard case.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
去找史密斯谈谈吧。他的测试可能相当严格。他是负责确保大家还清欠债的人之一。所以，他可能会是个难缠的角色。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Yeah...
That guy can be pretty anal, but we need a guy like him in our guild. Anyway, be careful. Lots of luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
是啊...
那家伙可能有点死板，但我们需要公会里有这样的人。总之，小心点。祝你好运，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Heh heh...
Fresh meat. This'll be
a cinch to--Wait! Er, I wasn't talkin' about you! I meant the other fresh meat~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿嘿...
新来的肉。这肯定很轻松--等等！呃，我不是在说你！我是说其他新来的肉~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh hey, it's you!
You did a good job, guy.
Now, lemme change your
job to Rogue. You earned it!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦嘿，是你！
你干得不错，伙计。
现在，让我把你的职业转职为流氓。你值得拥有！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh! It's you!
You were actually able to put up with that guy? Good stuff! Must've had a rough time collect all those items, eh?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦！是你！
你真的忍受了那个家伙？真厉害！收集那些物品一定很费劲吧？

[马基]
恭喜~！
你看起来
超酷的！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Congrats!
You've been
doin' a great job~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿嘿~
恭喜！
你一直
表现得很棒~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Now...
It's time
for me to make
a speech~ *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[马基]
现在...
是时候
让我发表
一番演说了~ *咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Enjoy your freedom as a Rogue. Just remember that you gotta be free and responsible at the same time. So treat other guys the way you wanna be treated, kay? Alright, seeya round.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
享受你作为流氓的自由吧。但记住，自由和责任是并存的。所以，像希望别人对待你那样去对待别人，好吗？好了，回头见。

scripts.text: Hold on, I need to get ready!
scripts.translation: 等一下，我需要准备一下！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Get ready...?
Fine, fine.
Take your sweet
time, why don't you?
But hurry up and
come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
准备一下...？
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，不着急。
但快点回来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Listen carefully, and
pick the right answer.
Capish? Now, lemme
read these questions...
scripts.translation:
[马基]
仔细听，
并选择正确的答案。
明白了吗？现在，让我
读一下这些问题...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Choose the skill necessary for learning ^880000Stalk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 选择学习^880000潜遁^000000所需的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. In comparison to the Merchant's Level 10 ^880000Discount^000000 skill, how much more of a discount, in terms of percent, can a Rogue get with Level 10 ^880000Haggle^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 与商人的10级^880000低价买进^000000技能相比，流氓使用10级^880000强制减价^000000技能能多获得多少百分比的折扣？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. What is the correct description for the skill, ^880000Mug^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 关于技能^880000偷钱^000000，下列描述正确的是？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. How many Rogues does it require to activate the skill, ^880000Slyness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 发动技能^880000流氓天国^000000需要几名流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the skill that you can learn at Level 5 ^880000Divest Helm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 请选择可以在5级习得的技能^880000卸除头盔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the skill which allows its user to move while hiding.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 请选择允许使用者在隐匿状态下移动的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the card that increases the accuracy rate of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 请选择能增加持有者命中率属性的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the monster that receives more damage when it's attacked by a weapon with the Vadon card (20 % more damage on Fire property).
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 请选择在受到带有螃蟹卡片的武器攻击时，会承受更多伤害的魔物（火属性伤害增加20%）。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. How much SP does the skill ^880000Double Attack^000000 require when used with a Dagger?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 使用短剑时，技能^880000二刀连击^000000需要消耗多少SP？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the most efficient dagger to use in the Byalan Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 请选择在拜兰地下城中效率最高的短剑。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Which monster drops a slotted Gladius?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 哪种魔物会掉落带孔的短剑（Gladius）？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Which monster drops a slotted Main-Gauche?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 哪种魔物会掉落带孔的主副手短剑（Main-Gauche）？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the class that is able to create unique potions.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 选择能够制作独特药剂的职业。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. Choose the weapon that Rogues aren't allowed to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 选择流氓不能使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the property that the monster Hode possesses.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 选择蚯蚓拥有的属性。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the monster that is unable to be tamed for as a Cute Pet.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 选择无法被驯服为可爱宠物的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the monster that receives more damage from a Dagger with the Fire property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 选择受到火焰属性短剑伤害更高的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the town that doesn't have any guild castles.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 选择没有公会城堡的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the plant that drops Blue Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 选择掉落蓝色药草的植物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the monster that does not have the Undead property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 选择不具有不死属性的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. By what percentage is the flee rate increased when a Thief masters the ^880000Improve Dodge^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 当盗贼精通^880000残影^000000时，逃跑率提高百分之多少？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Choose the monster that detects a characters using the Hiding or Cloaking skill.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 选择能发现使用隐匿或伪装技能角色的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the location where Thieves can change their jobs to Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 选择盗贼可以转职为流氓的地点。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. In which town can Novices change their jobs to Thieves?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 在哪个城镇，初心者可以转职为盗贼？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the card that does not affect the DEX stat.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 选择一张不影响DEX（敏捷）属性的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. So what's cool about being a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 那么，成为流氓有什么酷的地方？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. When is it possible to change jobs from Thief to Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 什么时候可以从盗贼转职为流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. You want to dye your hair blue. What town do you go to, and in which direction, with 12 o' clock being North.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 你想把头发染成蓝色。你应该去哪个城镇，朝哪个方向走？（以12点钟方向为北）

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the mushroom that is required on the Thief job change quest.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 盗贼转职任务中需要哪种蘑菇？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the card that least benefits the Rogue class.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 哪种卡片对流氓职业最没有帮助？

[马基]
*呼~*
终于结束了。
我们考完了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Good. You passed.
We don't gotta
do that again.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了...
{0}分。
不错，你通过了。
我们不用再来一次了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Aw crud... You failed!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了...
{0}分。
哎呀...你不及格！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
But don't get too comfortable just yet, you got more o' these tests. Your next one will be from Smith.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
但先别太放松，你还有更多的测试。你的下一个考官是史密斯。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So...
Go find Smith and finish up this test, yeah? Be careful though, Smith's a pretty anal guy.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
所以...
去找史密斯完成这个测试，好吗？不过要小心，史密斯是个很挑剔的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Man, you shoulda learned more when you had the chance. Thanks for wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
天哪，你当初应该多学点东西的。谢谢你浪费我的时间。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
*Sigh...* Lemme give you some tips, yeah? I'm supposed to tell you about some kind of ^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000 to help you learn what you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
*叹气...* 让我给你一些提示，好吗？我本该告诉你一些关于 ^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000 的事情，帮助你学习你需要知道的知识。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Of course, I don't know what the heck it means, but if you understand it, it'll probably help you out a lot.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
当然，我不知道那是什么意思，但如果你能理解它，它可能会对你很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Whoa, slow down newbie. We only accept people who are at least Thief Job Level 40. I ain't risking myself by letting you in before you're ready. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哇，慢点，新手。我们只接受至少盗贼职业等级40的人。我可不冒风险让没准备好的人进来。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Huh...?
What's an Assassin doin' here? Uh, you haven't been assigned to kill someone in the Rogue Guild, are you?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
嗯...？
刺客来这里干什么？呃，你不会被派来杀流氓公会的某人吧？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
In any case, don't mess with us! You can't catch me... I'm a smooth criminal!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
总之，别惹我们！你抓不到我...我是个滑头的罪犯！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Don't get it, huh? It's something I always used to say to Huey. If you're in the Assassin Guild, you oughta have met him...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
不懂吗？这是我以前常对休伊说的话。如果你在刺客公会，应该见过他...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Long time no see.
Eh, right now we don't
any requests from the
guild for you, so just
check back again later.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
嘿~
好久不见。
呃，现在公会没有
给你的任务，
所以请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Hey you...
Get your ugly
ass out of here
before I redecorate
that face of yours!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
喂，你...
把你那张丑脸
从这儿滚出去，
不然我就把你那张脸
重新装饰一下！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Welcome to
the Rogue guild.
From here on, I will
verify your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
欢迎来到
流氓公会。
从现在开始，我将
核实你的资格。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before we get started,
I want you to know
about something...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
在开始之前，
我想让你知道
一些事情...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
All new Rogues are required to pay an application fee, so I hope you take care of that first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
所有新流氓都必须缴纳申请费，所以我希望你先处理好这件事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What you have to understand is that the Rogue Guild does a lot of business, ^666666sometimes illegally^000000, that needs financial backup.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你要明白，流氓公会从事很多业务，^666666有时是非法的^000000，这需要资金支持。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know......
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know........
By the way.....
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...
顺便说一下...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Oh man...
This is...
Damn...
Annoying!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
天哪...
这...
该死...
真烦人！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Today, I'm in a pissed off mood, ya' know why?! I haven't collected any bills! God! Idiot Thieves coming at me all the time, wanting to become Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
今天我很生气，你知道为什么吗？！我还没收到任何账单！天哪！那些愚蠢的小偷总是来找我，想成为流氓！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Jesus! Now I understand why our leader told us that working as customer support sucks.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
天哪！现在我明白为什么我们的首领说做客服很糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That god damn guild master assigned me to this shitty job. I'm better than this F$@king job!
That bastard should go to F$@king hell, I'm gonna kick that mother F$@kers ass! F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那个该死的公会会长把我分配到这种破工作。我比这种F$@king工作强多了！
那个混蛋应该去F$@king地狱，我要踢那个母亲F$@kers的屁股！F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That dipshit who just tried to change his job, the one before you...
You know what the f#@k he talked to me about?!?
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那个刚才试图转职的白痴，在你之前...
你知道那个f#@k他跟我说了什么吗？！?
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the--?! What's with this chat filter?! Stop #*!@$ing me! you stupid F#$%*! Let me talk!!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
该死的--？！这是什么聊天过滤器？！别#*!@$我！你个愚蠢的F#$%*！让我说话！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f#@k you looking at...? {0}? That's your name!?
 
[{1}]
Umm...
Sir...?
I didn't mean to make you upset. I just came here to so I could become a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你f#@k在看什么...？{0}？那是你的名字！？
 
[{1}]
呃...
先生...？
我不是故意让你生气的。我只是来这里想成为流氓。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Holy shit on a stick, what the f#$k was I just f!#king talking about, you moron!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
该死，我刚才到底在f#$k说什么啊，你这个白痴！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Just leave me alone! Just leave alone! Just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
别管我了！别管我了！别管我了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Do whatever you want, okay? Just do whatever the F$!!K you want...!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你想怎么样就怎么样吧，行吗？就随你F$!!K意...！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think about coming back until you've got all those or I'll kill you where you stand.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
没把这些东西都弄齐之前，别想回来，否则我就把你当场杀掉。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the F$@k? Did you just say I'm annoying you? Shut up, you ungrateful prick!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么F$@k？你刚才说我很烦？闭嘴，你这个忘恩负义的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I just added ^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000 to the list. You better get it!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我刚刚在清单上加了^FF000010 变身叶子^000000。你最好把它弄到手！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! Haven't you ever thought about how hard it would be to be an NPC!?!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k！你有没有想过当NPC有多难啊！?!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Three thousand, two hundred seventy two. Three thousand, two hundred seventy three. Three thousand, two hundred seventy four...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
三千二百七十二。三千二百七十三。三千二百七十四...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uhh...
Headache...
This is too much
zeny to count.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃...
头疼...
这Zeny
数也数不完。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uh...?
What are you doing here? If you're going to talk about the job change, you need to speak to the other guy first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃...？
你在这里做什么？如果你要谈转职的事，你得先去找另一个人。

[史密斯先生]
...该死！
我数乱了！

[史密斯先生]
嗯...让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Wow, you've brought each and every single thing I asked you to. Good work... I salute you.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
哇，你把我让你带的每一样东西都带来了。干得不错...我向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Since you showed such great effort, I'm going to write a recommendation letter for you. I usually don't do that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
既然你表现得如此出色，我要为你写一封推荐信。你知道的，我平时可不会这么做。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
But I'm sure you'll be a great asset to the Rogue Guild. Hmm, I don't have a blank piece of paper right now, so take this instead...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
但我确信你会成为流氓公会的得力干将。嗯，我现在手头没有空白纸张，所以先拿这个代替吧...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Sigh...*
I know, I know. I'm supposed to control myself in the work place. Getting enraged is a bad habit...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*叹气...*
我知道，我知道。在工作场所我应该控制自己的情绪。发火是个坏习惯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Mumble mumble...*
How was I... *Mumble...*
How did... I remember...
*Sigh* It was all because of my bad temper!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*咕哝咕哝...*
我刚才... *咕哝...*
我怎...我记得...
*叹气* 都是因为我脾气不好！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt might be a better
idea to come back later.^000000

[Mr. Smith]
Listen this time!
Application fee:
^FF000010000 zeny^000000,
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!
^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think
of coming back
without them!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
别想着不带齐这些东西就回来！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Let me see...
Who would should
I send you to...?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
让我看看...
我该把你派给谁呢...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Right! I know
just the guy~!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
对了！我知道一个合适的人~！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go visit Aragham Junior who lives South of the Sandarman Fortress. That area is located one field east from here.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去拜访住在桑达曼要塞南边的阿拉甘·朱尼尔。那个区域就在我们这里往东一个地图的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's a pretty nice guy, you know. He works hard and is really good at bill collecting.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他人挺好的，你知道的。他工作很努力，而且很擅长讨债。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before he joined the Rogue Guild, people have been trying to kill him for something his father did in the past. So, he became a runaway.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
在他加入流氓公会之前，因为父亲过去的所作所为，一直有人想杀他。所以，他成了逃犯。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well anyway, that's why he's been with us. We've been helping him hide from his enemies.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
总之，这就是他为什么和我们在一起。我们一直在帮他躲避敌人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password if you want to meet him. He doesn't let anybody in his house without the password.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想见他，最好记住密码。没有密码，他不让任何人进他的房子。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是 ^0000FF阿拉甘从不囤积强化道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well, I will wish you luck. His place isn't that far from here, so come back as soon as possible. Being swift... That is the spirit of the Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好了，祝你好运。他的地方离这里不远，所以尽快回来。敏捷...这就是流氓的精神。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
这家伙可能很适合你，但是...
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I want you to meet Antonio Junior, son of Antonio the first. For some reason people have been trying to kill him because of something his father did in the past.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我想让你见见安东尼奥二世，他是初代安东尼奥的儿子。不知为何，因为父亲过去做过的事，一直有人想杀他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He was brought up in Payon, but he's staying in an empty house near the Kokomo beach at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他是在斐扬长大的，但现在住在克克魔海边的一栋空房子里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I've heard lately that he's been complaining a lot about the noise outside of his house, and he fears an assassination attempt. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
最近听说他一直在抱怨屋外的噪音，还担心有人要暗杀他。总之...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's kind of tense, so he throws a dagger at anyone who approaches his house. He has a violent personality.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他有点紧张，所以会向任何靠近他家的人扔短剑。他的性格很暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, he does have magnificent business skills. And he also loves gambling. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不过，他有着出色的商业头脑。而且他还喜欢赌博。一旦你了解了他，他会很好地指导你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想见他，最好记住密码。密码是 ^0000FF安东尼奥不喜欢破坏强化道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
这家伙可能很适合你，但是...
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
His name is
Hollgrehenn Junior,
a genius at manipulation.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他的名字是
霍尔格雷恩二世，
是个操纵天才。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, because of something his father did long ago, people have been trying to kill him. Because of this, he is very high strung and will throw daggers at people he doesn't trust.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不过，因为父亲很久以前做过的事，一直有人想杀他。因此，他非常神经质，会向他不信任的人扔短剑。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Our leader has been able to get him to join our guild, and his brilliant mind has been an asset to us. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我们的首领成功让他加入了公会，他聪明的头脑对我们很有帮助。一旦你了解了他，他会很好地指导你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊，如果你想见他，最好记住密码。密码是 ^0000FF我父亲从不囤积强化道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright... Now that I've calmed down, I can inform you of your next destination. *Whew*
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好了...现在冷静下来了，我可以告诉你下一个目的地了。*呼*

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go and find Hermanthorn Junior, who is living near the ^0000FFthe checkpoint of Paros Lighthouse^000000, which is at the border between Morocc and Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找赫曼索恩二世，他住在 ^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔检查点^000000 附近，那里位于莫罗克和克魔岛的交界处。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah...almost forgot, keep in mind not to mention anything about upgrading items. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊...差点忘了，记住不要提任何关于强化道具的事。这非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你刚才说
你忘了要去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Head one field East and enter the building that is South of the Sandarman Fortress to meet Aragham Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
向东走一个区域，进入桑达曼堡垒南边的建筑，去见阿拉甘二世。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是 ^0000FF阿拉甘从不囤积强化道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你刚才说
你忘了要去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the building
at Kokomo Beach,
which is on the way
to Comodo, to meet
Antonio Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去克克魔海边的建筑，
那里在去克魔岛的路上，
去见安东尼奥二世。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是 ^0000FF'安东尼奥不喜欢破坏强化道具'^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你刚才说
你忘了要去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the field South of Sandarman Fortress, which is on the way to Morocc from here, to meet Hollgrehenn Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去桑达曼堡垒南边的区域，那里在从这里去莫罗克的路上，去见霍尔格雷恩二世。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
密码是 ^0000FF我父亲从不囤积强化道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmmm...?
Don't you have
to go somewhere
else to complete
your Rogue training?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你不是应该去别的地方
完成你的流氓训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
First, the
application fee:
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
首先，申请费：
^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...?
What was that?
Did you just say that
you're willing to donate
more for the guild?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
刚才说什么？
您是说愿意为公会
捐赠更多吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That sounds sweet,
I appreciate that.
But come back when
you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
听起来很贴心，
我很感激。
但请准备好后再来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Okay, we've got the application fee, ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000, {0} {1}, {2} {3}, {4} {5} and {6} {7}...

[Mr. Smith]
Great, great...
I think you
brought everything.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
很好，很好...
我想您
都带齐了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright, wait just a moment while
I prepare these things. Let's see... Your next test is...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好的，请稍等，
让我准备一下这些东西。让我看看... 您的下一个测试是...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f$@k!? You didn't bring all the required items?! Are you telling me that you need to check the requirements again!?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
该死的！您没带齐所有要求的物品吗！您是在告诉我需要再确认一下要求吗！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Now listen...!
Bring ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000,
and the following items...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
听好了...！
带来 ^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000，
以及以下物品...

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那里？！
谁敢
闯入我的领地？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那里？！
谁敢
闯入我的领地？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那里？！
谁敢
闯入我的领地？

[{0}]
霍尔格雷恩
不喜欢

霍尔格雷恩
不喜欢

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I see...
You must be from
the Rogue guild.
You must be one of the
ones Mr. Smith wasn't
too happy with...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
原来如此...
你一定是来自
流氓公会的。
你肯定是那个
让史密斯先生
很不满意的人之一...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
He threw a fit and you brought him all the items he asked for, didn't you? Well, I can see that you're still pretty naive. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他大发雷霆，而你却乖乖地给他弄来了所有他要的东西，对吧？看来你还是很天真嘛。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I suppose he suckered you into gathering those items, and then passed you on to me. Sad, really.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
我想他应该是骗你去收集那些物品，然后再把你推给我。真是可怜啊。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well, since you were tortured by him, I'll try to be especially generous to you. My test for you will be simple, so simple.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
既然你被他折磨过，我会对你特别宽容一点。我的测试很简单，非常简单。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
All you have to do is go through an underground tunnel, and walk all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
你只需要穿过地下隧道，然后一路走回流氓公会就行了。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
There is one thing I should tell you, though. You might want to be careful inside, alright?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
不过有一件事我要提醒你。里面可能有点危险，你最好小心点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
A bunch of pricks have been throwing Dead Branches and casting Hocus Pocus all over the place...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
有一群混蛋到处扔枯枝，还到处施放幻术...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Just make it back to the Rogue Guild alive. That's all you have to do!
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
总之...
只要活着回到流氓公会就行了。这就是你要做的！

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Oh right. This is really important. You need a password to enter the tunnel. To unlock the door, the four number combination is ^0000FF3019^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
对了。这很重要。进入隧道需要密码。要打开门，四位数字组合是 ^0000FF3019^000000。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Huh...?
What the hell
are you doing here.
Scram, why don't you?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
咦...？
你在这里干什么。
滚开，懂吗？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked. You'll need to enter the four number combination to open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF门被锁住了。你需要输入四位数字组合才能打开它。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt didn't work. Please re-enter the four number combination.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF没有成功。请重新输入四位数字组合。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFPlease enter a combination of four numbers.^000000

[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Didn't I tell you
that I changed the
password? *Wink Wink*
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哎呀...
我是不是告诉过你
我改了密码？*眨眼眨眼*

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you must be
from the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你一定是
来自流氓公会的...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
My name is
Aragham Junior,
Rogue of the Desert.
Are you ready to learn
how to be a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
我叫
小 阿拉甘，
沙漠流氓。
你准备好学习
如何成为一名流氓了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
See, as a Rogue, our motto is, '^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000' That rule especially goes true for monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
你看，作为流氓，我们的座右铭是，'^0000FF避开强者！欺凌弱者！^000000' 这条规则对魔物尤其适用。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Avoid the strong!
Be malicious to the weak!
It's a simple rule...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
避开强者！
欺凌弱者！
这是一个简单的规则...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Now, remember it as you go through ^0000FFthe Underground Tunnel^000000. Try to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
现在，当你穿过 ^0000FF地下隧道^000000 时，记住这一点。试着一直走到流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
There will be a few monsters, but don't worry. I know you're strong. Alright, are you ready to go or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
会有一些魔物，但别担心。我知道你很强大。好了，你准备好出发了吗？

[小 阿拉甘]
好的...
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，
准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you're back.
I think you'll do well this time. Another motto Rogues have is '^0000FFFailure teaches success^000000.' Well, then again...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你回来了。
我想这次你会做得很好。流氓们还有另一句座右铭是'^0000FF失败教会成功^000000'。嗯，不过话说回来...

[小 阿拉甘]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好吧，好吧。
慢慢来，
准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
咦...？
你是谁？！
你可不是
流氓公会的！！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
You've come here to kill me, haven't you? N-no! I'm can't die yet! Get lost! Otherwise, I'll kill you first!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
你过来是想杀我的，对吧？不...不行！我还不能死！滚开！不然，我先杀了你！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Hey...
what brings
you back here?
Why don't you
take a rest
before you leave?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嘿...
怎么又
回来了？
离开之前
不休息一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...
From the
Rogue guild, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
咦...
来自
流氓公会的，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
I'm Hollgrehenn Junior. I tend to a lot of our underground business. So are you ready to take on my test?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我是小 霍尔格雷恩。我负责处理我们地下的许多事务。那么，你准备好接受我的测试了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
We Rogues share this motto: ^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 This rule applies to any threat, especially monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我们流氓共有这句座右铭：^0000FF避强击弱！欺善怕恶！^000000 这条规则适用于任何威胁，尤其是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
It's easy to remember.
Just don't forget to put it into practice. You got it?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
很容易记住。
只要别忘了付诸实践。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
For my test, you'll go through the ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000. Follow it all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
作为我的测试，你要穿过^0000FF地下隧道^000000。沿着它一直走回流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
There are some monsters there, but that'll be part of your training. Now, are you ready to go or not?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
那里有一些魔物，但这将是训练的一部分。现在，你准备好出发了吗？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢来。
准备好了
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh.
You failed.
Gonna try again?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
哼。
你失败了。
还要再试一次吗？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢来。
准备好了
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...?
You're not from
the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
咦...？
你可不是
流氓公会的...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
You better get out
of here right now
if you know what's
good for you...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
如果你知道什么对自己好...
最好现在就滚出这里...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Now...
Beat it before
I change my mind
about killing you.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
现在...
趁我还没改变主意
杀了你之前，
赶紧滚。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Hey...
Come to visit?
We Rogues gotta
stick together, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嘿...
来拜访的？
我们流氓
得团结一心，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You're from
the Rogue guild?
If you wanna learn
about becoming a Rogue,
then shut up and stay put.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你来自
流氓公会？
如果你想学习
如何成为流氓，
那就闭嘴站好。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 That's our motto for battling monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
^0000FF避强击弱！欺善怕恶！^000000 这是我们战斗魔物的座右铭。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Show no mercy when you fight weaker monsters, and try to keep away from stronger monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
战斗时，对弱小的魔物不要留情，
并尽量远离强大的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Now, I want you to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild through this ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
现在，我要你穿过这条^0000FF地下隧道^000000，
一直走到流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
There are monsters there, but if you avoid the strong and be malicious to the weak, you'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
那里有魔物，但只要你避开强大的，
欺负弱小的，就没问题。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I hope you do
not fail this test
You can only become
a Rogue if you pass...
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我希望你不要
在这次测试中失败。
只有通过测试，
你才能成为流氓...

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没时间跟你
瞎扯。快点，
准备好，然后
接受测试。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You failed...?
I guess that's life.
Are you gonna try
again or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你失败了...？
看来这就是命。
你还要再试一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Remember, I'm doing
you a favor here...
Now, don't come back
until you're a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
记住，我这是在
帮你一个忙...
现在，在你成为流氓之前，
别回来。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没时间跟你
瞎扯。快点，
准备好，然后
接受测试。

scripts.text:
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你是谁？！
你不是来自
流氓公会的！！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You've come here to kill me?! I won't let you!! Come on, give me your best shot! You can't fight if I rip out your eyes!
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你来到这里是为了杀我？！我不会让你得逞的！！来吧，使出你的全力！如果我挖出你的眼睛，你就没法战斗了！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Hey, how's it goin'?
Take it easy, and just
relax before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
嘿，感觉怎么样？
放轻松，
离开前好好休息一下。

scripts.text:
^F08080Tah dah~
Monsters for the
Rogue Job Change
have been reset^000000.
scripts.translation:
^F08080瞧~
流氓更换职业的
魔物已重置^000000。
